telnaUsageTrace.clientRefresh: WirelessDashboard fetches GET /api/wireless/status when mounted or when currentUser changes; it has no interval timer. EsimActivatePage checks activation once for a loaded PROVISIONING subscriber and also offers a manual check; it does not continuously poll Telna.
telnaUsageTrace.serverRefresh: Authenticated GET /api/wireless/status reads up to 10 recent unexpired packs with positive local balance and, for each real providerPurchaseId, calls fetchEsimUsage. A missing or mock package ID keeps cached balance. Provider failures also keep cached balance. A replacement request makes an additional authoritative usage read before transferring entitlement.
telnaUsageTrace.telnaUsageRequest: Outbound Bearer-authenticated GET /v2.1/pcr/packages/{package_id} to configured TELNA_API_BASE. Package ID comes from providerPurchaseId, not ICCID/profile ID. data_usage_remaining bytes become remaining MB; expiry and ACTIVE/NOT_ACTIVE package status are returned. Telna does not provide total/used MB in this adapter.
telnaUsageTrace.balanceSafety: The status path persists a refreshed remaining balance only as a decrease, retains local plan total, and translates replacement-package capacity against the customer's transferred entitlement. It selects a provider ACTIVE pack and separately shows NOT_ACTIVE queued top-ups. The client displays the returned local/verified balance.
telnaUsageTrace.activationRequest: For transitional eSIM activation, the API makes an outbound GET /v2.1/esim-rsp/euicc-profiles/{iccid}; ENABLED is required before marking active. This is separate from data-usage balance.
telnaUsageTrace.timersAndWebhooks: No server timer, cron, provider callback registration, or Telna webhook subscription call appears in deployed usage call sites. /esim/webhooks/oneglobal only logs and returns 200 without changing usage or subscriber state. /api/wireless/webhooks/:provider is behind requireAuth and its provider normalizer is a stub; it is not an operational external Telna usage webhook. TELNA_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not configured.
telnaUsageTrace.reusedValidation: Merged PR #145 reports a real Local 3 GB purchase, installed Telna eSIM with cellular data, usage accounting verified against Chatforia, repeat purchase on the same ICCID, and active/queued package behavior. Existing telnaEsim and wireless tests assert package-ID GET, byte-to-MB conversion, ACTIVE selection and non-increasing customer entitlement; they were inspected, not rerun.
telnaUsageTrace.firewallConclusion: Usage/balance refresh depends on API outbound HTTPS to Telna, not inbound Telna traffic. API inbound Cloudflare-only rules do not block this pull flow if existing outbound access is retained. An actual Telna-initiated event would depend on inbound rules only if the account has an enabled webhook subscription; its state and destination must be confirmed with Telna.
